mapper.select: SELECT participant_id AS participantId, session_id AS sessionId, user_id AS userId, display_name AS displayName, custom_identity AS customIdentity, position_index AS positionIndex FROM talk_session_participant WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY position_index, participant_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO talk_session_participant (session_id, user_id, display_name, custom_identity, position_index) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{displayName}, #{customIdentity}, #{positionIndex})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM talk_session_participant WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT t.user_id AS userId, t.teacher_name AS displayName FROM talk_teacher t JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.dept_id = #{collegeId} AND t.status = '0' AND u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.teacher_name, t.user_id
